title: Japan bids farewell to Asian Games after fortnight of turmoil and records
summary: The 20th Asian Games closed on Sunday after a rocky fortnight lit ​up by youthful brilliance in the sporting arenas but tempered by logistical dysfunction and subdued public interest.
